layers.name: Market Data Sources
layers.description: Fetches and manages market data from external APIs and databases for stocks and investment funds.

layers.name: Application Core
layers.description: Core application infrastructure including queues, caching, Redis integration, external data sources, and error handling.

layers.name: Domain Models
layers.description: Core entity classes representing stocks, funds, simulations, and investment analysis strategies.

layers.name: HTTP Endpoints
layers.description: Express route handlers and controllers for REST API endpoints serving stock, fund, and simulation data.

layers.name: Build Configuration
layers.description: Development settings and GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow configuration.

layers.name: Utility Helpers

layers.name: Domain Types
layers.description: TypeScript type definitions and interfaces for financial domain models including stocks, indicators, dividends, and prices.

layers.name: Worker Scripts

layers.name: Integration Tests
